== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The Deep [[Aion]] refers to the most dangerous and remote regions of the [[Aion Sea]], a vast ocean characterized by supernatural phenomena and eldritch threats. While the shallow waters are accessible to common sailors, the deep [[Aion]] is inhabited by ancient [[Elders]], massive leviathans like [[Deepstriders]], and various other monsters or phantoms. The sea itself was formed by the death throes of [[Nakothi]], an event that leveled a continent. It is a place where the laws of nature are often replaced by the bizarre, featuring phenomena such as floating islands that resemble corpses and storms where [[water]] falls upward. Navigating these waters requires specialized ships built by the Navigator’s Guild{{!}}Navigator's Guild, which utilize parts of [[Elderspawn]] to guide crews through the hazards. Only a small number of these vessels are capable of safely traversing the deep [[Aion]], often relying on [[Soulbound]] captains to manage the connection between the ship and the sea's immense power.}}
